what: a swamp serpent: a real cottonmouth water snake, drawn large, a short, thick, heavy-bodied snake with a blunt wedge-shaped head and keeled scales. Its body lies in one tight round coil, and from the middle of the coil its neck rises in an S with the head thrown back and the jaws gaping as wide as they go, seen from the side, showing the inside of the mouth, which is plain cotton-white, with two short curved white fangs. Its scales are dull dark mud-brown with broad darker brown-black crossbands and a pale yellow-tan belly. A plain snake, painted seriously like a plate in a natural history book.
colours: dull dark mud-brown scales, the colour of wet peat, with brown-black crossbands, a pale yellow-tan belly, a cotton-white mouth lining, white fangs, a small dark eye with a pale tan stripe above it.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its thick body is wound in one tight coil, and its neck rears up out of the coil in an S, the head thrown back and tilted up with the jaws gaping wide open toward the upper left in a threat, the white mouth plainly seen, the tail tip lifted at the right.
must_show: a thick-bodied dark brown banded snake in a tight coil
the head thrown back with the jaws gaping, the inside of the mouth white
a plain real snake: no hood, no horns, no glow
the plainest and smallest of the serpents

what: Ra's serpent: the uraeus, the rearing cobra of the pharaoh's crown come alive, a real Egyptian cobra drawn large, painted seriously. The front third of its body rears straight up with its broad flat hood spread wide, seen from the front and a little from the side, and the rest of its body lies behind in two thick loops. Its scales are bright polished gold over the whole body, with dark bronze edges to every scale, and the spread hood is marked with broad bands of dark red carnelian and black enamel like a pharaoh's jewel. Its head is a plain cobra's head, smooth and bare on top. Its eyes are two bright ruby-red points, and one short jet of orange and yellow flame shoots straight out of its open mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head.
colours: bright polished gold scales with dark bronze edges, dark carnelian-red and black bands on the hood, ruby-red eyes, white fangs, a short orange and yellow flame.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The front of its body rears tall and upright at the left with the hood spread wide and the head tipped forward to strike toward the lower left, jaws open, the one short flame spitting from its mouth; the rest of its body curves away behind it to the right in two thick loops with the tail tip raised.
must_show: a rearing cobra with a wide spread hood
bright gold scales over the whole body
red and dark bands on the hood like enamel
a bare cobra head with ruby eyes
one short jet of flame from its mouth
must_not_show: sun rays round the whole snake

what: a Norse sea serpent: the great sea-orm that Olaus Magnus drew on his sea chart of 1555, a very long, thick, eel-bodied serpent, painted seriously. It has a long narrow head like a huge pike's, with a jutting lower jaw full of long needle teeth and one pale glaring eye, and from the back of its head and down its neck hangs a long shaggy mane of coarse grey-white hair, stiff with ice. A low jagged fin of spines runs along its back. Its whole body is covered in sharp overlapping slate-grey scales, and every scale is edged with white frost; thick icicles hang in a row from its lower jaw and from the underside of its neck. Its thick body is piled in two or three great looping coils.
colours: dark slate-grey scales edged with white frost, a paler ash-grey belly, a grey-white mane of hair, white icicles, a pale yellow eye, ivory teeth. No brown and no gold anywhere.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its neck rears high out of its looping coils at the left with the maned head lunging to the left, jaws wide open, and the thin tail whips up at the far right.
must_show: a long thick slate-grey serpent reared out of great looping coils
a shaggy grey-white mane of hair down its neck
white frost on the scales and icicles hanging from its jaw
a long pike-like head with needle teeth
larger and stranger than a plain snake

what: a sable serpent: a giant black constrictor snake as thick as a tree trunk, painted seriously, heavy and menacing. Its scales are black as wet coal and glossy: every coil carries a long bright streak of pale steel-grey highlight along its top, and each large scale is picked out with a pale grey edge, so that the round thick shape of the body reads clearly. Its belly, seen where the coils turn, is banded with broad pale ivory plates. It has a big, broad, arrow-shaped head with heavy brow ridges, two burning amber-yellow eyes with slit pupils, and a wide-open mouth with a pale ivory lining and two very long curved ivory fangs. Its body is piled in three massive overlapping coils.
colours: glossy coal-black scales with pale steel-grey highlights and scale edges, a pale ivory banded belly, amber-yellow eyes, a pale ivory mouth lining and long ivory fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body is heaped in three massive coils at the right, and its thick neck shoots forward and up out of them to the left in a striking lunge, the big head level with the jaws wide open and the long fangs bared, the ivory belly bands showing along the underside of the neck.
must_show: a massive glossy black snake in heavy coils
pale grey highlights so the black body reads as round and scaled, not a flat black shape
a pale ivory banded belly
amber eyes and very long ivory fangs in a wide-open mouth
far bigger and heavier than the swamp serpent

what: the world serpent: Jormungand of the Norse myths, the serpent that circles the whole world and bites its own tail, painted seriously as the most ancient and mighty of all serpents. Its enormously thick body is bent into one great closed ring, a circle that fills the picture, with empty space in the middle of the ring. At the upper left of the ring is its head, and its jaws are clamped on the tip of its own tail. The head is a great dragon's head: long and heavy, with a crown of six long backward-sweeping horns of pale bone, a ridged armoured brow, a burning amber eye and big ivory teeth. All round the outside of the ring runs a tall crest of jagged dark spines. Its scales are huge armoured plates, like slabs of sea-worn rock, dark teal-grey with tarnished bronze edges, and clusters of pale barnacles grow on its back.
colours: dark teal-grey armoured plate scales with tarnished bronze edges, a pale sand-tan belly on the inside of the ring, black back spines, pale bone horns, pale grey-white barnacles, an amber eye, ivory teeth.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Its whole body forms one great tilted ring, like a wheel seen a little from the side: the horned head at the upper left bites down on the tail tip, the thick body sweeps round to the right, down and back up again to meet it, with the spined crest on the outside of the ring and the pale belly on the inside.
must_show: a serpent bent into one closed ring, biting its own tail
a dragon's head with a crown of long pale horns
huge armoured plate scales, dark teal-grey with bronze edges
a jagged crest of spines round the outside of the ring
plainly the mightiest of the serpents

what: a shade: one of the strengthless dead of Homer's underworld, a ghost and not a living man, painted seriously and sadly. It is a tall, thin, stooping phantom, made entirely of pale ghost-light, every part the same pale colour: pale bone-white with a faint grey-green tint, nearly white, like cold mist, with dark grey-green shadow in the folds and hollows so that it reads as solid. It is wrapped from the crown of its head to its hem in one long thin burial shroud of the same pale mist-colour that clings to it, and the shroud is tattered: long ragged strips trail from its elbows and from its hem. Its face is a hollow ghost's face under the edge of the shroud, hairless and beardless: two large round pitch-black eye-holes, a long black hole of an open wailing mouth, sunken cheeks, nothing else. Its arms are long and thin as sticks, with long thin spread fingers. Below the knees the shroud narrows into one long ragged tapering tail of pale mist that trails away behind it to the right, joined to the body.
colours: pale bone-white ghost-light with a faint grey-green tint on every part of it, face, hands and shroud alike, dark grey-green shadows in the folds, pitch-black eye-holes and mouth.
wears: It wears only its long tattered burial shroud, drawn over its head like a veil and hanging in thin clinging folds, the same pale ghost-colour as the rest of it. No belt, no jewellery.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: both long thin arms are stretched out ahead to the left, one high and one low, the long pale fingers spread and grasping at warmth.
pose: It drifts forward to the left in mid-air with nothing beneath it, bent far forward from the waist, its head lifted and its black mouth gaping in a silent wail, both thin arms reaching out ahead at different heights, the tattered shroud and the long tail of mist streaming out behind to the right, joined to the body.
must_show: plainly a ghost: pale bone-white all over, drifting, with a trailing tattered tail and no feet
a hollow face: black eye-holes and a black wailing mouth, no beard
a thin tattered shroud over head and body
both thin arms reaching, hands empty
the plainest and weakest of the shades: no horns, no wings, no armour, nothing held
must_not_show: bedsheet ghost with round eye holes
cloud of mist round the body

what: a nightmare shade: a bad dream that outlived its dreamer, a tall hunched shroud of dark smoke wearing a monster's face, painted seriously with depth and light. Its face is one big solid mask of pale grey-white bone, plainly the brightest thing in the picture: the long skull of a horned beast, with a long narrow muzzle, a row of big bared fangs, two tall thick curling horns of the same pale bone sweeping up and back, and two narrow slanted eye slits filled with sickly yellow-green light. The mask hangs at the top of one tall, torn shroud of smoke with nothing inside it, black as coal, like ragged soot-black gauze painted in deep hanging folds and tatters, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges, and a sickly yellow-green light edges every fold along its left side with a thin bright line. Out of the shroud at the front reach two long thin streamers of the same black smoke, each ending in a hand of five very long curved claws of pale bone. The shroud narrows downward and ends in long ragged tatters.
colours: coal-black smoke with dark slate-grey ridges, never brown, a thin sickly yellow-green rim light along its left edges, a pale grey-white bone mask and horns, pale bone claws, yellow-green eye slits.
wears: It wears only the horned bone beast-mask, which is its face.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in empty air and looms over to the left, the shroud curling forward like a breaking wave, the horned bone mask thrust forward and down toward the lower left with its fanged jaws open, both long pale-clawed hands spread wide in front to seize, its tattered lower part twisting away to the lower right.
must_show: a big pale bone beast-mask with tall curling horns and bared fangs
a torn shroud of coal-black smoke painted in folds, with nothing inside: no muscles, no legs
a sickly yellow-green light on its edges and in its eye slits
long pale bone claws on both hands, held clear of the body
reads clearly on a dark background
must_not_show: grinning mouth in a black face

what: a succubus shade: the faded ghost of a she-demon who preys on sleepers, worn so thin that lamplight passes through her, painted seriously as a sorrowful and dangerous ghost. She is a figure made entirely of pale ghost-light in the shape of a tall, slender, graceful woman in a long gown: every part of her, her face, her hair, her horns, her wings and her gown alike, is the same translucent pale ash-grey with a faint dull mauve tint, like cold mist at dusk, with dark slate-grey in the folds and hollows, drawn solid enough to read clearly; she is never bright pink. Nothing on her has any other colour: no skin colour, no blonde or brown hair, no gold cloth. She has a cold, gaunt, sharp-featured face with hollow cheeks and two eyes of bright rose-red light, the only strong colour on her, long hair flowing behind her, two short curved horns on her brow, and a pair of small tattered bat wings on her back, their edges fraying into wisps. Her fingers end in long thin claws. She has the realistic proportions of a tall adult woman, about eight heads tall, with a small head and long limbs.
colours: translucent pale ash-grey ghost-mist with a faint dull mauve tint on every part, face, hair, wings and gown alike, with dark slate-grey folds and hollows, two bright rose-red eyes. No skin colour, no gold, no brown and no black anywhere.
wears: She wears the ghost of a long, modest, high-necked gown with long sleeves that covers her from the throat to the ground, made of the same pale ash-grey mist as the rest of her, its long skirt fraying at the hem into trailing wisps that hide her feet.
holds: Both of her hands are empty and she holds nothing: her right hand is stretched forward, palm up, beckoning with one clawed finger, and her left hand is raised beside her shoulder with the claws spread.
pose: On two legs hidden by her long gown, she glides forward to the left, leaning into it with her weight on her front foot, her right arm extended ahead beckoning, her left claw raised beside her shoulder, her head tilted and her glowing eyes on the viewer, her hair, tattered wings and the wisps of her skirt streaming behind to the right.
must_show: a ghost in the shape of a slender woman in a long modest gown, all of one pale ash-grey with a faint mauve tint, not bright pink
small tattered bat wings and two short horns, the same pale colour
two bright rose-red eyes
both hands empty with long claws, one beckoning
the hem of the gown fraying into wisps: no feet

what: a Duat shade: the soul of an ancient Egyptian that came apart in the dark water of the underworld, a drifting thing of dark smoke that still wears its burial jewels, painted seriously with depth and light. It is one tall, torn shroud of smoke hanging in the air with nothing inside it, black as coal and never brown, painted in deep folds, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges. Its top has the outline of an Egyptian king's striped headcloth seen from the front: a smooth rounded dome with two broad flat lappets hanging down, one on each side, striped in dull gold and coal-black. Where the face would be, between the lappets, there is only a smooth oval of darkness with two long, narrow, almond-shaped eyes of solid bright turquoise light. Just below, lying across the front of the shroud, is one broad, solid, flat collar of bright gold, a wide half-circle of gold bands set with turquoise stones, plainly seen and catching the light. Two long thin limbs of the same black smoke reach out of the shroud, each with one broad gold band on it, each ending in a long thin hand of pale grey fingers. A strong turquoise light edges every fold along its left side. Below the collar the shroud unravels: it streams away downward into three or four long thick curling ribbons of smoke.
colours: coal-black smoke with dark slate-grey ridges, the black of coal and never brown, a turquoise rim light along its left edges, two bright turquoise eyes, a broad bright gold collar with turquoise stones, gold arm bands, a headcloth striped in dull gold and coal-black, pale grey hands.
wears: It wears the ghost of a striped Egyptian headcloth, and solid gold burial jewels: one broad gold collar and two gold arm bands.
holds: Both of its pale hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It drifts forward to the left through empty air, tilted and leaning, both long limbs stretched out ahead to the left with the pale fingers spread to cling, its lower part streaming away to the lower right in long curling ribbons of smoke.
must_show: a smoke figure with the outline of an Egyptian striped headcloth
one broad bright gold collar, solid and plain to see
two narrow almond eyes of turquoise light and a turquoise rim on the smoke
pale reaching hands, empty
the lower part unravelling into ribbons of smoke; painted with folds and depth
must_not_show: human face with nose and lips

what: a valkyrie shade: the ghost of one of Odin's shield-maidens who fell from his favour, painted seriously. She is a figure made entirely of pale ghost-light in the shape of a tall, strong, grim warrior woman in full war gear: every part of her, her face, her braids, her helmet, her mail, her boots, her spear shaft and her cloak alike, is the same translucent pale gold-white, like mist lit by a low winter sun, with darker dull grey-bronze in the folds and hollows, drawn solid enough to read clearly. Nothing on her has any other colour: no skin colour, no brown leather, no dark hair, no black feathers, no steel grey. Her face is stern and hollow-cheeked, with two eyes of bright white light, and two long thick braids hang from under her helmet. She has the realistic proportions of a tall adult woman, about eight heads tall, with a small head and long limbs.
colours: translucent pale gold-white ghost-light on every part, face, hair, helmet, mail, boots and feathered cloak alike, with darker dull grey-bronze folds and hollows, two bright white eyes, a spearhead of bright white-gold light. No skin colour, no brown, no black and no steel grey anywhere.
wears: She wears the ghost of a round helmet with a nose guard and two swept-back raven wings fixed to its sides, a knee-length mail shirt belted at the waist, arm guards, tall boots, and a long ragged cloak of big feathers that hangs from her shoulders and frays into wisps. All of it is made of the same pale gold-white light as she is.
holds: She holds exactly one spear in her right hand: a thick straight shaft of the same pale light, taller than she is, with one long, broad, leaf-shaped head that blazes bright white-gold, the brightest thing in the picture. Her left hand is empty: the arm is stretched forward and down with the open hand reaching to seize. She has no shield and no sword.
pose: On two legs, she lunges forward and downward to the left with her front knee deeply bent and her rear leg stretched behind, her right arm raised high and drawn back with the thick spear held overhand, level, its glowing head pointing to the left, her empty left hand reaching down ahead of her, her braids and feathered cloak streaming up behind to the right.
must_show: a ghost in the shape of a warrior woman, all of one pale gold-white light, face and gear alike
a helmet with two raven wings and a mail shirt
one thick spear with a blazing head, in the right hand, thrusting
a long ragged cloak of feathers, the same pale colour
two white eyes; the left hand empty and reaching
the most armed and armoured of the shades
must_not_show: big angel wings on her back
spear held upright like a staff

what: a shadow demon: a fiend that lost its body and kept its hatred, a small gaunt winged devil-shape cut out of darkness, painted seriously with depth and light. Its body is dark but plainly shaded: coal-black in the hollows and dark slate-grey on every ridge, rib and muscle, so that its whole form can be read. It has a narrow head with two long curved horns of pale bone-white sweeping back, each as long as its face and as thick as a finger, a lean hunched ribbed body, and two big ragged bat wings: the finger-ribs of the wings are coal-black and the torn membranes between them are a dull dark ember-red, like embers seen through smoke, tattered at the edges. A strong ember-red light shines on it from the left, so that the ridge of the back, the arms and every wing rib are edged with one thin bright line of ember red. Its eyes are two large slanted slits of bright red-orange light, like two coals. Its two long thin arms end in hands of very long curved claws of pale bone-white. The pale horns and the pale claws of its two hands are the only pale things in the picture. Below the ribs its body narrows into one thin whip-like black tail.
colours: coal-black body shaded with dark slate-grey ridges, wing membranes of dull dark ember-red between coal-black ribs, a thin bright ember-red rim light along its left edges, two bright red-orange eye slits, pale bone-white horns and pale bone-white claws on the two hands.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Both of its clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It swoops to the left through empty air, its ragged wings raised high in a V behind it, its horned head thrust forward, both long arms reaching straight out ahead to the left at the height of its own head with the pale claws spread wide, its thin tail whipping up behind to the right. Nothing hangs below its body.
must_show: a small gaunt winged demon shape, coal-black shaded with slate-grey so its form reads on a dark floor
two ragged bat wings with black ribs and dull ember-red membranes
two pale bone-white horns and two bright coal-red eye slits
long pale bone-white claws on both hands, reaching ahead at head height
a thin ember-red light on its edges; no clothes, no weapon, no jewels

what: a shadow hound: Black Shuck, the ghostly black dog of the East Anglian churchyards, a real dog on four legs, seen from the side, as big as a calf, painted seriously and frighteningly. It is a huge, gaunt, shaggy hound with a wolf's long heavy head, a wrinkled snarling muzzle with the lips curled back from the teeth, torn ears laid flat, a deep chest, a thick neck with raised hackles and long legs. Its rough coat is coal-black and dark charcoal-grey, painted in long shaggy locks with dark slate-grey highlights along the back, the neck and the legs so that the dark dog reads clearly, and a strong sulphur-yellow light edges its head, hackles and back. Its eye is large, slanted and filled with bright sulphur-yellow fire, with no pupil, the brightest thing in the picture, and its jaws are wide open showing a row of long pale ivory fangs above and below. Its front half is solid; its hindquarters are only half there: the fur of its rump, hind legs and tail streams away backward in long ragged tatters.
colours: a shaggy charcoal-grey and black coat with paler ash-grey highlights, never tan, a sulphur-yellow rim light, bright sulphur-yellow eyes, pale ivory fangs, a dark grey tongue.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing: no collar.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it bounds forward with its front legs reaching out and its hind legs driving behind, its body horizontal, its big head low and thrust forward, snarling, with the jaws wide open and the long fangs bared, its ears flat and its hackles up, its tattered hindquarters and tail streaming out behind to the right.
must_show: a huge gaunt shaggy black hound on four legs, seen from the side
pale highlights on the dark coat so it reads clearly, not a flat black shape
two burning sulphur-yellow eyes
long pale fangs in open jaws
the hindquarters streaming away into ragged smoke

what: a soul shadow: the tangled souls of many people who died together, knotted into one thing, painted seriously and grimly with depth and light. It is one tall, leaning column of darkness, like a great knot of thick twisting ropes of smoke, deep charcoal-black and dark slate-grey with a few grey highlights on the twists, and a strong deep blue light edges the twists along its left side. Pressing out of the upper half of the dark mass are three big pale faces, each a third of the column wide, one above another and turned different ways: each is a plain, solid, bone-white mask like an ancient theatre mask of grief, hairless, with two big hollow black eye holes and a big black mouth hole stretched wide open in a silent cry, plainly the brightest things in the picture, their edges sinking back into the dark. From the upper left of the column two long thick ropes of darkness lash outward, each ending in one big bone-white clutching hand. The base of the column is torn and ragged.
colours: deep charcoal-black and dark slate-grey twisting smoke, a deep blue rim light along its left edges, three big bone-white mask faces with black eye and mouth holes, two bone-white hands.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Its two pale hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: The whole column leans and surges over to the left like a wave about to fold over, lopsided, its top curling forward, the two long limbs with pale hands flung out to the left to drag something in, the three pale mask faces crying out in different directions.
must_show: one leaning column of knotted darkness, painted with twists and depth
three big bone-white crying mask faces set in the mass, each plain to see with black eye and mouth holes
two pale hands on long dark limbs reaching out
a deep blue light on its edges
reads clearly on a dark background

what: a shadow: the darkness a wicked soul cast, left behind and standing up by itself, painted seriously with depth and light. It is one tall, ragged sheet of darkness hanging in the air, like a torn curtain of soot-black gauze and smoke blown toward the left, with nothing inside it: wide at the top, where it bulges into one rounded hump, and narrowing all the way down into one long thin tattered tail that bends sideways at the bottom. It is painted in deep hanging folds and tatters like heavy torn cloth, soot-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges, with a ragged, shredded outline. A torch shines on it from the left, so a thin bright line of amber light runs down its whole left edge. High in the rounded hump are two narrow slanted slits of bright white light, with no pupils. From the upper part of the sheet two long ragged streamers of the same dark stuff reach far forward to the left, and each streamer ends in one big wide hand of five long, thin, pointed fingers of pale ash-grey, spread wide, the palest things in the picture.
colours: soot-black folds with dark slate-grey ridges on every part, one thin amber rim line down its left edge, two white eye slits, pale ash-grey long-fingered hands.
wears: It wears nothing: no hood, no cloak, no crown.
holds: Both of its pale hands are empty and it holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in empty air and billows over to the left like a torn curtain in a wind, bent like a hook, its rounded top curling forward, both long streamers stretched out ahead to the left with the big pale hands spread to touch, its long tattered tail bending off to the lower right.
must_show: a tall ragged sheet of darkness, wide and rounded at the top and tapering to a tattered tail, painted in folds
a thin amber light down its left edge
two narrow white eye slits high in the dark
two big pale long-fingered hands, empty, reaching on long dark streamers
plain, with no gear at all; reads clearly on a dark background
must_not_show: flat black silhouette with no shading

what: a shadow master: a shadow that has drained so many of the living that it half remembers being a lord, painted seriously with depth and light. It is one tall, broad, commanding shroud of smoke hanging in the air with nothing inside it, black as coal and never brown, like torn soot-black gauze painted in deep folds, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey on the ridges. At the top the smoke stands up in a tall, stiff, flaring collar, and below it the shroud spreads wide and falls in heavy folds, torn into long tatters at the bottom. Inside the collar there is only a smooth oval of pure darkness with two long slanted slits of bright white light, with no pupils. On top of that darkness sits a solid crown of tarnished silver, plainly seen and catching the light: a broad band with five tall points, two of them snapped off short. A cold white light shines on it from the left, so the collar, the crown and every fold on its left side are edged with a thin bright white line, and thick white frost crusts the edge of the collar and the tattered hem. Out of the shroud come two long thin black limbs of smoke, each ending in a hand of long curved claws of white ice.
colours: coal-black smoke with dark slate-grey ridges on every part, the black of coal and never brown, a thin white rim light along its left edges, two white eye slits, a tarnished silver crown, white frost on the collar and hem, white ice claws, one jagged ball of white ice.
wears: It wears one tarnished silver crown with two broken points, and a long high-collared mantle that is part of its own smoke.
holds: Its right hand is empty and raised high: in the open clawed palm sits one jagged ball of white ice as big as the crown, a cluster of sharp ice crystals, touching the claws. Its left hand is empty: the white claws are spread and reaching forward low. It holds no weapon and no staff.
pose: It glides forward to the left through empty air, tall and leaning into it, its crowned top lowered toward the viewer, its right limb lifted high and back with the ball of ice ready to throw, its left claw reaching forward and down to the lower left, the torn shroud streaming behind to the right.
must_show: a tall shroud of coal-black smoke with a high flaring collar, painted with deep folds, not brown
a solid tarnished silver crown with broken points above a faceless dark oval
two white eye slits; a thin white light and frost on its edges
white ice claws on both hands
one jagged ball of white ice in the raised right palm
plainly a lord over the plain shadow: crowned, collared, armed with ice

what: a shadow archer: a living human bowman trained in a hidden tower to shoot from the dark and never be where the arrow came from, lean, tall and still, painted seriously. He is seen in full profile like a figure on a coin, facing left. His hood is up and a dark cloth wraps the lower half of his face, so that only a strip of pale skin and one narrow eye show. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: a hooded coat of soot-black cloth, black as coal in the folds and dark charcoal-grey on the ridges, a lining and a waist sash of deep dark violet, black leather bracers, belt and boots with dull pewter buckles, a black face wrap, pale skin round the eye, a big bow of pale ash-grey wood, pale bone-white arrows with deep violet feathers, a bright violet glow on one arrowhead.
wears: He wears a long hooded coat of soot-black cloth that reaches his knees, split at the back into two long tails lined with deep dark violet, a deep violet sash at the waist, a black face wrap, black leather bracers, a broad black belt, tall soft black boots, and on his back a big quiver full of pale bone-white arrows with deep violet feathers. A short plain sword in a black scabbard hangs at his hip, sheathed. Hood, coat, sleeves, trousers and boots are all black as a shadow; only the lining and sash are violet.
holds: He draws exactly one bow: a big, thick, sturdy recurved bow of pale ash-grey wood, as tall as he is, held upright at arm's length in his left hand, a single D shape at the left of the picture, entirely in front of him. His right hand is drawn back to his cheek holding one thick pale arrow on the string, and the arrow's head, at the bow, is wrapped in a ball of bright violet light as big as his fist with dark smoke curling off it. He holds nothing else: the sword stays in its scabbard.
pose: Seen in full profile, facing left, on two legs in a wide archer's stance with his front knee bent and his weight on his back leg, leaning back into a full draw, the pale bow upright at the left, the arrow level and aimed to the left, his coat tails and sash swinging out behind to the right.
must_show: a hooded, masked human archer all in soot-black, a shadow of a man, in full profile facing left
one big pale bow at full draw, a single D shape in front of him
a bright violet glow with dark smoke on the arrowhead
a quiver of pale arrows with violet feathers; violet only on lining and sash
a living trained man with legs and boots, not a ghost

what: a shadow assassin: a killer of an order like the old Assassins of Alamut in Persia, who has bargained his own shadow away so that he can walk inside the dark, a lean, wiry, athletic living man dressed entirely in black, painted seriously. His whole head is wrapped in a black turban, and a black cloth mask covers his nose, mouth and chin up to the bridge of the nose, so that only two narrow dark eyes and a thin strip of light brown skin show. His clothes are coal-black and dark charcoal-grey, painted with dark slate-grey highlights on every fold so that they read clearly. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall. He casts no shadow; instead, thick black smoke pours off his back and off the tail of his coat and streams out behind him in three long ragged ribbons, joined to his coat like a tattered cape of smoke.
colours: coal-black and dark charcoal-grey cloth with dark slate-grey highlights, a black turban and black face mask, a broad dull dark red sash, a thin strip of light brown skin round the eyes, black leather gloves, bracers and soft boots, one knife with a bright silver-white steel blade and a brass hilt, black smoke streaming from his back.
wears: He wears a black turban wound close round his head, a black cloth mask over his nose and mouth, a plain knee-length black wrap-over coat with a crossed front, no buttons and long close sleeves, a broad dull dark red sash wound round his waist, loose black trousers tucked into soft black boots, and black leather gloves and bracers. No cloak, no hood, no armour. No skin shows except round his eyes.
holds: He holds exactly one knife in his right hand: a short, broad, straight, double-edged blade no longer than his hand, bright silver-white steel, the brightest thing in the picture, with a brass crossguard, held point-down in a stabbing grip. His left hand is empty: an open black-gloved hand stretched forward with the fingers spread to grab. He holds no second blade.
pose: He springs forward to the left with his front knee bent and his body low and twisted, his right arm raised high above and behind his head with the bright knife pointing down to stab, his empty left hand reaching out ahead, the ribbons of black smoke streaming from his back and coat tail to the right, touching him.
must_show: a man all in black: black turban, black mask over nose and mouth, only the eyes showing
a plain black wrap-over coat with a broad dull dark red sash
one short bright steel knife raised in the right hand, the left hand empty
ribbons of black smoke streaming from his back, joined to him
highlights on the black cloth so he reads clearly, not a flat black shape
must_not_show: loose puffs of smoke apart from the body

what: a lizardfolk shaman: the eldest of a marsh warren, an old, lean, stooped scaled marsh-dweller that stands upright on two legs, as tall as a man. It has the head of a real monitor lizard: a long flat snout, a wide mouth of small sharp teeth, small cold yellow eyes with slit pupils, a loose wrinkled throat, and a low ridge of short spines from its brow down the back of its neck. Its whole body is covered in scales: chest, belly, arms and legs, faded with age, and it has one long, thick, heavy tail. Its hands and its three-toed feet are clawed. It has a small head and long limbs.
colours: faded dull olive-green scales with darker brown-olive bands on the back and tail, a pale yellow-tan belly and throat, yellow eyes, a domed turtle shell of dark brown and tan plates, small chalk-white snake skulls, a dull ochre-yellow hide kilt, a dark brown wooden staff, a few white heron plumes.
wears: It wears a ragged knee-length kilt of dull ochre-yellow hide, one big domed turtle shell of dark brown and tan plates strapped over its chest like a breastplate, and three heavy cord necklaces strung with big chalk-white snake skulls that hang down over the shell. Three tall white heron plumes are tied upright at the back of its head. No armour and no robe.
holds: It holds exactly one staff in its right hand, gripped at the middle and held upright: a thick, crooked, dark brown wooden staff as tall as itself, with one big chalk-white snake skull with long fangs lashed to its top. Its left hand is empty: a clawed hand raised with the fingers spread in a warding sign.
pose: On two legs, it stalks forward to the left, stooped, with its weight on its front foot, the skull-topped staff planted upright ahead of it in its right hand, its empty left claw raised beside its head, its neck stretched forward and its mouth wide open spitting, its heavy tail swung out behind for balance.
must_show: an upright lizard-man with a long flat snout and a thick tail, olive scales and a pale belly
a turtle shell strapped on the chest
necklaces of white snake skulls
one crooked wooden staff topped with a snake skull, in the right hand
white plumes at the back of the head; the left hand empty
plainly the shaman beside a plain lizardfolk hunter: shell, skulls, staff, plumes

what: a frost skeleton: a soldier who froze to death on a winter march and never thawed, a bare human skeleton held together by ice. Every bone is crusted in pale blue-white rime, the skull, ribs, spine, arms, hands, legs and feet alike, with dark gaps between the ribs, and thick icicles hang from its lower jaw like a beard and from its elbows and ribs. Its eye sockets are black and empty. A thin frozen crust of snow lies on the top of its skull and shoulders. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: pale blue-white frosted bone on every part with dark grey-blue shadows between the ribs, white icicles and snow, black empty eye sockets, one stiff frozen scrap of dull grey-brown wool cloak, a dark leather strap.
wears: It wears only one torn, stiff, frozen scrap of a soldier's dull grey-brown wool cloak hanging from its left shoulder, held by one dark leather strap across its ribs. No armour, no helmet, no robe.
holds: Both of its bony hands are empty and it holds nothing: its right arm is drawn back with the frosted fist clenched to strike, and its left arm reaches forward with the frosted finger bones spread wide to touch.
pose: On two legs, it lurches forward to the left with its front knee bent and its weight on its front foot, its left arm stretched out ahead with the fingers spread, its right fist drawn back by its shoulder, its jaw hanging open, the frozen cloak scrap sticking out stiffly behind.
must_show: a bare skeleton crusted in pale blue-white frost on every bone, the skull included
icicles hanging from the jaw like a beard, and from the elbows
one stiff scrap of grey-brown cloak on a strap: no armour
both hands empty: one fist back, one reaching
black empty eye sockets, no glow; the plainest of these skeletons
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: a skeletal giant: the dug-up skeleton of a giant of the ancient world, walking again, a skeleton and nothing else, with no muscle and no flesh on it anywhere, so big that it fills the whole picture from edge to edge. It is built nothing like a man's slim skeleton: it is squat, hunched and enormously broad, nearly as wide as it is tall, with every bone three times as thick as a man's. Its skull is huge and heavy-browed, sunk low between the shoulders with no neck, with a massive square jaw of big blunt teeth and deep black eye sockets. Its ribcage is as broad and round as a great barrel, made of six very thick ribs with wide black gaps between them. Its arm bones are as thick as tree posts, thicker than its leg bones, and hang down past its knees, ending in huge bony hands with knuckles like stones; its leg bones are short, thick and bowed. All of the bone is old, cracked and chipped, dull grey-brown like something dug out of a grave. In one huge hand it grips a whole ordinary human skeleton, which in that hand is tiny: a small limp slim skeleton no longer than the giant's own forearm, held round the ribs like a doll.
colours: old dull grey-brown bone with dark brown cracks on every part of the giant, never gold and never white, black gaps and sockets, one tiny paler ivory human skeleton in its hand, a few dark brown rotted leather thongs at the hips.
wears: It wears only a few rotted dark leather thongs at its hips. No armour, no helmet, no cloth, no shield.
holds: It holds exactly one thing in its right hand, raised high overhead to throw: a whole small human skeleton, limp, gripped round the ribs in the giant's huge bony fist, its little skull and thin arms and legs dangling. Its left hand is empty: a huge bony hand spread open, stretched forward low.
pose: On two short bowed legs, hunched, it stamps forward to the left with its front leg lifted to stomp and its weight on its back leg, its right arm raised high over its head gripping the small human skeleton to hurl it, its long left arm reaching forward low with the huge bony fingers spread, its heavy jaw hanging open.
must_show: a squat, hunched, enormously broad skeleton of very thick bare bones: no muscle, no flesh
a huge heavy-browed skull sunk between the shoulders, a barrel ribcage with wide black gaps
arms thicker than its legs, hanging past the knees
one tiny whole human skeleton gripped in the raised right hand, showing how big the giant is
dull grey-brown grave bone, not gold; black eye sockets with no glow
must_not_show: small figure in the middle of the picture

what: a skeleton necromancer: a necromancer who outlived his own body and still calls his servants with a clattering of teeth, a tall, thin, stooped human skeleton in a dead scholar's dress. His head is a bare ivory skull with black empty eye sockets and the jaw dropped wide open, and inside the open jaws there is only empty pitch-black darkness. His hands are bare bone. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a long coal-black robe with paler grey highlights on its folds, a broad dull ochre-yellow stole with black runes, a belt of big ivory finger bones, one long pale ivory bone spike, a ball of sickly yellow-green flame, black empty eye sockets.
wears: He wears a long, ragged, coal-black robe with wide torn sleeves that reaches the ground, and over it a broad dull ochre-yellow stole that hangs round his neck and down the front on both sides to his knees, stitched with big black runes. Round his waist is a belt strung with big ivory finger bones. No hood, no hat, no crown: his skull is bare.
holds: He holds exactly one bone spike in his right hand, held up like a dagger: one long, straight, sharp splinter of pale ivory bone as long as his forearm, thick at the grip and tapering to a point. His left hand is empty and raised high: a round ball of sickly yellow-green flame as big as his skull burns in the open bony palm, touching the fingers. He has no staff and holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left, stooped, with his weight on his front foot, his left arm raised high ahead of him with the yellow-green flame in its palm, his right hand cocked back at his shoulder with the bone spike ready to throw, his skull thrust forward with the jaw wide open, his black robe and yellow stole swinging.

a long black robe with a broad ochre-yellow rune stole down the front
one sharp bone spike in the right hand
a ball of sickly yellow flame in the raised left palm
a caster: no armour, no sword

what: a skeleton champion: the skeleton of a master swordsman of the ancient world who has forgotten everything but his drill, poised and exact. His head is a bare ivory skull, plainly seen in an open-faced helmet, with black empty eye sockets. His arms, hands, thighs and feet are bare ivory bone with no skin or flesh anywhere, and his bare spine shows between the breastplate and the hips. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a tarnished dark bronze breastplate and helmet with brighter bronze edges, a tall stiff helmet crest of dark red horsehair, a ragged dark red half-cloak, a belt of dark brown leather straps with bronze studs, dark bronze shin guards, a sword with a pale bright steel-grey blade and a bronze hilt.
wears: He wears an ancient bronze breastplate, tarnished dark, over his ribs; an open-faced bronze helmet with cheek guards and a tall stiff crest of dark red horsehair running from front to back; a skirt of dark leather straps studded with bronze at his hips; bronze guards on his shins; and a short, ragged dark red half-cloak hanging from his left shoulder. His arms are bare bone. No mail and no shield.
holds: He holds exactly one sword in his right hand: a long, straight, broad, double-edged blade as long as his leg, pale bright steel-grey with a notched edge and a bronze crossguard and pommel. His left hand is empty: an open bony hand held out behind him for balance, like a fencer's. He has no shield and holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, in a swordsman's deep lunge to the left: his front knee bent and his rear leg stretched straight behind, his right arm fully extended with the long blade pointing level to the left, his empty left hand raised behind him, his skull level and fixed on the point, his red crest and half-cloak swinging back.
must_show: a bare skull in an open-faced bronze helmet with a tall dark red crest
a tarnished bronze breastplate, with bare bone arms and legs
one long straight sword in the right hand, in a fencer's lunge
the left hand empty: no shield
a ragged dark red half-cloak
finer gear and a surer stance than a skeleton warrior, and no glow

what: a skeleton horde: the dead of one lost battle risen together and still keeping formation, drawn as one tight block of skeleton soldiers packed shoulder to shoulder, all touching, one solid mass, painted seriously. In the front rank are three large skeleton soldiers side by side, seen from the front and a little from the left, their three big round shields overlapping in a wall across their bodies, each with a bare ivory skull under a dented helmet and a notched sword raised above the shield. Close behind them, packed against their backs, rises a second rank: four more helmeted skulls looking over their shoulders, and above them a dense fence of a dozen thick spears and swords slanting forward. From the middle of the block stands one tall pole with a long, torn, dark red war banner. Bare bone legs show below the shields. All the iron is rusted very dark brown.
colours: ivory bone skulls and limbs, helmets, shields and blades of rusted iron, very dark brown, the colour of an old iron nail, nearly black in the shadows, with dull grey-steel edges, pale wooden spear shafts, one torn dark red banner.
wears: Every skeleton wears a dented rusted iron helmet and scraps of rusted mail.
holds: Each front-rank skeleton holds exactly one big round rusted shield and one notched sword; the rear rank holds spears.
pose: The whole block advances to the left as one, leaning forward behind its wall of three overlapping shields, the front rank's swords raised, the spears of the rear rank slanting forward over their heads to the upper left, the torn red banner streaming back to the right above them.
must_show: many skeleton soldiers packed into one tight block, not one figure
a wall of three big overlapping round shields across the front
a row of helmeted skulls above the shields, and more behind
a fence of spears and swords above, and one torn dark red banner
rusted dark iron and ivory bone; all touching, one mass

what: a snake charmer: a lean, sly, weather-beaten living man of about fifty from the bazaars of old Samarkand on the Silk Road, painted seriously. He has light brown skin, a long hooked nose, narrow dark eyes, hollow cheeks and a pointed grey-black beard. A big live cobra is draped round his shoulders like a scarf: its thick body lies across the back of his neck, its tail hangs down his right side, and its front part rears up beside the left side of his head with its hood spread wide. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: light brown skin, a grey-black beard, a big white turban, a long coat in broad vertical stripes of dark blue and saffron-yellow, a dull dark red sash, loose tan trousers, brown leather slippers with curled toes, a tan and dark brown cobra with a pale cream throat, a pipe with a tan gourd and two pale reed tubes, a curved knife with a bright steel blade and a brass hilt.
wears: He wears a big white wound turban, a long knee-length quilted coat in broad vertical stripes of dark blue and saffron-yellow, a dull dark red sash round the waist, loose tan trousers and brown leather slippers with curled toes. The live cobra lies round his shoulders.
holds: He holds exactly one snake charmer's pipe in his left hand, raised with its mouthpiece at his lips: a thick wooden pipe as long as his forearm with a round tan gourd as big as his fist swelling in its middle and two pale reed tubes below. He holds exactly one knife in his right hand, low at his hip: a short, broad, strongly curved blade no longer than his hand, bright steel, with a brass hilt. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he sways forward to the left with his weight on his front foot and his knees bent, playing the gourd pipe held up to his lips in his left hand, his cheeks puffed, the curved knife held ready low at his right hip, his eyes fixed on the viewer, the hooded cobra reared beside his head and his striped coat swinging.

one gourd pipe held to his lips in the left hand

a live hooded cobra draped round his shoulders, reared beside his head
a living human with a sly weathered face
